name: qir-optimizer
description: A hybrid-aware, self-verifying optimizer for QIR (Quantum Intermediate Representation)

scripts.evidence: vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=web/src/data/tests.json && tsx src/cli/main.ts bench --out bench && cp bench/results.json web/src/data/bench.json && sed -i.bak "s#$PWD/##g" web/src/data/tests.json && rm -f web/src/data/tests.json.bak
scripts.evidence:fast: vitest run --reporter=json --outputFile.json=web/src/data/tests.json && tsx src/cli/main.ts bench --out bench --fast && cp bench/results.json web/src/data/bench.json
